subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should Telegram pinned-message reads be added as an explicit on-demand action, an opt-in session-start context source, or kept out of core for now?
rationale: The code change is feasible, but deciding whether agents may read persistent Telegram room context and how that access is gated is a product/security boundary rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: On-demand gated read
options.body: Add a Telegram action or command that fetches the current pinned message only when explicitly requested and gates it through channel action/tool policy.

options.title: Opt-in session context
options.body: Allow pinned content to be imported at session start only behind an explicit per-chat or per-account opt-in with clear docs and tests.

options.title: Do not add now
options.body: Leave this out of OpenClaw until a broader Telegram read-policy design covers pinned messages and message history together.

recommendation.title: On-demand gated read
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram action or command that fetches the current pinned message only when explicitly requested and gates it through channel action/tool policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing candidate from recent Telegram/channel-extension history and the issue timeline subscription signal.
